translation_notes: the three simple existence checks (g.value(source, csvw:url)/sd:endpoint/d2rq:jdbcDSN, called with 2 positional args so `default` stays None) translate cleanly to m{ {source} {prop} ?v }(g).first().

the final g.value(None, RDF.type, rml_vocab.D2RQ_NS.Database, True) could NOT be translated: its 4th positional argument is g.value's `default` parameter, not a unique/any flag -- a real bug in pyrml (an unmatched pattern silently returns True instead of None, and 'if db:' then fires unconditionally, causing an early return of [SQLSource.from_rdf(g, True)] on the very first source that reaches the else branch). m{ }.first() has no `default=` to reproduce this with, so this one call is left as native g.value(...) in translated.ldpy, verbatim, to keep both sides equally (and identically) buggy. Classified awkward rather than directly-expressible for this reason -- flagged, not forced.

context_shim.py stands in for pyrml/rml_vocab.py (real namespace IRIs, fetched from the pinned commit) plus minimal Source/SQLSource stand-ins for the region's two external calls; Source.__build is assigned outside the class body so its name is not mangled, matching how the extracted top-level function (originally a class body statement) resolves `Source.__build` unmangled once it lives outside the class.

fixture.ttl uses two parents: parent1 exercises the three m{ }.first() islands for real (literal/table/sparql/sql sources), parent3 isolates the default-argument bug so both sides return [None] on it; parent2 is neighbourhood that must not match.
